chain_trace.break_detail: The contract's premise 'hnsw_ef minimum 1' could not be located in either verifiable documentation face: (a) the live concept page (qdrant.tech/documentation/search/search/, fetched 2026-09-04) states no minimum for hnsw_ef; (b) the published OpenAPI for v1.18.x (and every version v1.9.x..master in the repo's redoc archive) declares minimum: 0 for hnsw_ef, explicitly licensing the value 0. The contract was stored with source_status='degraded'/source_verified=false at mining time. The acorn_scale half of the same assertion is verbatim-documented (max_selectivity 0.0-1.0 default 0.4) and — unlike hnsw_ef — IS enforced at runtime (live 422). Downstream effect: the API behavior (200 on hnsw_ef=0) is consistent with the published machine contract; it violates only an assertion whose documentation basis is unverifiable.

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST POST /collections/{c}/points/query -> QueryRequest { #[validate(nested)] internal: QueryRequestInternal } -> internal.params: Option<SearchParams> with #[validate(nested)] (this is the machinery that produced the live 422 'internal.limit: value 0 invalid, must be 1 or larger' and 'internal.params.acorn.max_selectivity: value 1.5 invalid, must be from 0.0 to 1.0') -> SearchParams.hnsw_ef: Option<usize> carries NO #[validate(range(min = 1))] attribute although the struct derives Validate and sibling fields in the same struct (acorn.max_selectivity) and the same request object (limit, and HnswConfig.ef_construct on the create face) do carry range validators -> serde accepts any usize-representable value (0 accepted; -1 and '64' rejected 400 at type level) -> collection search path -> hnsw.rs search_with_graph: ef = params.hnsw_ef (Some(0) used as-is, NOT replaced by default; only None falls back to config.ef) -> graph_layers.rs search: ef = max(ef, top) runtime clamp -> with 6 points x dim4 below the default full_scan_threshold_kb, the plain full-scan path executes regardless, so hnsw_ef is functionally inert in the observed scenario. The only hnsw_ef bound anywhere is the opt-in strict-mode config upper bound search_max_hnsw_ef (verification/mod.rs:343-347, test_strictmode.py:427-458). grpc face: proto uint64 + conversions map to usize — same absent lower bound. The published OpenAPI 'minimum: 0' is schemars' automatic mirror of Option<usize>, not a hand-written semantic promise; no comment/docstring in source declares an intent to allow 0.

mundane_explanation.surviving: Two surviving considerations, neither exculpatory for the contract-as-written but material for adjudication: (1) the assertion's premise 'hnsw_ef minimum 1' is unverifiable in every currently-reachable documentation face, and the published OpenAPI v1.18.x explicitly declares minimum: 0 — i.e. the observed acceptance is CONSISTENT with the machine-published contract, so the defect reduces to concept-doc-vs-implementation divergence only if the min-1 premise was ever documented; (2) functional inertness — in the observed scenario (sub-full-scan-threshold collection) and generally via the max(ef, top) clamp, hnsw_ef=0 does not corrupt results, so impact is request-validation hygiene, not search correctness. Runtime clamp + OpenAPI minimum:0 could support a by-design argument, but NO explicit design declaration (comment/docstring/maintainer statement) exists in source, so by_design_in_source is not claimable.
